name: Windows NT 4.0
tagline: The workstation blue that ran the late-90s office.
description: Windows NT 4.0 brought the Windows 95 shell to the enterprise, with a distinctive blue-gray palette suited to professional workstations. Its default NT Blue projected seriousness over the consumer teal.
